title: Normalized coefficient and line comparison data
statement: Fix the finite-field datum [def-pur-conventions]: an algebraic closure k of a finite field of characteristic p and a prime ell different from p. Let E contained in F be finite extensions of Q_ell in the fixed coefficient closure [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let X,Y be separated finite-type k-schemes, X noetherian, and let f:X to Y be smooth separated of pure relative dimension d >= 0 [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-sf-setting], with a fixed open/proper compactification f=j followed by p. Use the ordinary derived categories of strict coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian], and their full normalized constructible subcategories with uniform cohomological and Tor bounds [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]. Choose the actual whole-system scalar models D [def-sp-field-shriek-system-models], their proper/open comparison laws b, domains a and tower/finite adjunctions A, with the unit/counit-normalized evaluations [def-sp-field-exceptional-system-domains, def-sp-field-exceptional-system-adjoints]. For H=E,F let J_H,T be the tower (O_H/ell^(n+1))_T, let L_H=J_H,X(d)[2d] in the ordered positive Tate tensor convention [def-sp-tower-gamma-data], choose its root-normalized finite coordinates on X and Y, and assume J_H,Y belongs to the normalized subcategory. Put omega_H=G_H(J_H,Y), where G_H is the supplied tower right adjoint. Suppose a_H:L_H isomorphic to omega_H has the specified finite diagonal/DNC orientations with these coordinates [def-pur-finite-smooth-canonical-maps]. Write C_T for whole-system scalar extension [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections], and c_K:C_X G_E K to G_F C_Y K for the actual counit transpose of C_Y(epsilon_E,K) after inverse b [def-sp-field-exceptional-system-components]. Then there exist isomorphisms q:C_Y J_E,Y to J_F,Y and t:C_X L_E to L_F, such that (i) each finite q component is the scalar unit multiplication, transported through the supplied unit and site coordinates; (ii) each finite t component is the scalar Tate-line comparison with identity on roots, tensored d times in the prescribed order [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor]; (iii) for every n >= 0, exact evaluation e_n sends C_X(a_E) followed by c_(J_E,Y) followed by G_F(q) to e_n(t followed by a_F). This is an equality of finite evaluations of actual whole-system arrows. It contains no assertion of equality of arbitrary derived arrows from their evaluations.

proof.text:
The quotient inclusions define the coefficient-unit comparison by multiplication.
On the Tate line use extension of the scalar coefficient with the identity on roots;
tensor d copies in their prescribed order and commute with the even shift. Finite
free extension on whole strict systems is exact, so these maps and their inverses
assemble in the abelian category and induce the displayed derived isomorphisms.
The ordinary tensor formulas and the canonical evaluation comparisons prove
IsUnitComparison and IsLineComparison, including n=0 and ramified field extensions.
The coefficient unit is constructible and has Tor amplitude [0,0]. Apply finite
reduction-compatibilities clause (3) at this unit, using finite-orientation-reduction
to identify the general-ring purity arrow with the specified diagonal/DNC arrow.
The normalized whole-system exceptional comparison is the counit transpose; evaluate
its defining counit equation using b.scalarEvaluation and A.counit. Uniqueness of the
finite transpose identifies it with the finite exceptional coefficient comparison.
Consequently the two sides of the asserted square agree at every positive level.
This is the finite equation for the actual already constructed tower arrows;
the conversion to their equality in the tower derived category is deliberately
left to the parent theorem's shifted-heart detection argument.

lean.statement: theorem field_orientation_comparison_data [IsNoetherian X] [X.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] [(j ≫ p).IsOver (Spec (.of P.field.k))] [IsSeparated (j ≫ p)] [QuasiCompact (j ≫ p)] [HasCompactification (j ≫ p)] (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (j ≫ p)] {E F : Index P} (hEF : E ≤ F) (wE : Coordinates P D E X) (wF : Coordinates P D F X) (vE : Coordinates P D E Y) (vF : Coordinates P D F Y) (hE : normalized P D E Y (SpTowerGamma.unit P.coefficients.l E.val Y)) (hF : normalized P D F Y (SpTowerGamma.unit P.coefficients.l F.val Y)) (oE : line P D wE d ≅ omega P D j p b a A E hE) (oF : line P D wF d ≅ omega P D j p b a A F hF) (hoE : IsOrientation P D j p b a A E d wE vE hE oE.hom) (hoF : IsOrientation P D j p b a A F d wF vF hF oF.hom) : ∃ (q : (D.scalars E F hEF Y).T.obj (SpTowerGamma.unit P.coefficients.l E.val Y) ≅ SpTowerGamma.unit P.coefficients.l F.val Y) (t : (D.scalars E F hEF X).T.obj (line P D wE d) ≅ line P D wF d), IsUnitComparison P D j p b hEF vE vF q.hom ∧ IsLineComparison P D j p b hEF wE wF d t.hom ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, (SpTowerShriek.Ev P.coefficients.l F.val X n).map ((D.scalars E F hEF X).T.map oE.hom ≫ (component P D (SpTowerGamma.factorization j p) b a A hEF (coefficientUnit P D E Y hE)).hom ≫ ((A.right F).map (ObjectProperty.homMk (Y := coefficientUnit P D F Y hF) q.hom)).hom) = (SpTowerShriek.Ev P.coefficients.l F.val X n).map (t.hom ≫ oF.hom)
